meta.title: Budget Consumption Tracking: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Switch between a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant when no tenant IDs are provided.

Open Budget Consumption Tracking and verify that it is refused or absent on Growth and available on Enterprise.
